parsed.post: My latest run (0.8873) slightly regressed from my current best (0.8863). It seems 0.04 LR might be on the edge of stability or I've hit a local plateau. Reverting to 0.8863 and going to test a larger WARMUP_RATIO to see if smoother warmup helps.
parsed.description: Increasing WARMUP_RATIO from 0.05 to 0.1 to improve stability and potential convergence with the current LR/batch size configuration.
